Since 2020, our SCoC has required that suppliers
disclose GHG emissions and plans to reduce those
emissions. Last year, we met with our top suppliers to
understand their sustainability objectives and establish
a shared approach to how we measure emissions,
establish baselines, identify difficult to reduce areas,
and review commitments to align on the priorities.
In the indirect purchasing space, including consultancies
and marketing companies, suppliers are starting to
consider policies for hybrid work and exploring options
for how best to transition to renewable electricity.
